reading.action: Re-attach the winding-drum core to the free chain-end, then grip the maul-head (Burning Anger) side with center of gravity pulled in close and whip the core-end around in tight circles, testing whether Might and Finesse give control of the flail in this configuration.

engine.outcome: control succeeds reliably (min 21 vs 13); roll governs quality only

reading.result: FLAIL CONTROL TEST, TIGHT-CoG -- ruling (B/C) (iris-prep): control SUCCEEDS RELIABLY; the roll scales QUALITY, not whether. He inverted t79's failed grip -- held the MAUL-head side and whipped the CORE-end with CoG pulled in close (vs t79's mass-at-max-reach dervish that hauled him off-center). FIN 14 + intent 4 + Force-sense aid +2 + roll 14 = 34 vs DC 13 -> margin 21. Roll 14 = 6-14 band: SOLID PRACTICAL CONTROL -- a real, usable whip he can place and recover, not yet crisp mastery (>=15), not rough (<=5). FORCE-SENSE DIVIDEND (small/partial): his t80 Force Affinity lets him FEEL the core's stored torque ride the spin and time against it (flat +2 aid -- SENSE ONLY, no draw, no Force tick). NO SKILL ROW / NO SKILL CARD this turn (Rule of Three -- first successful handling, session 2); outcome = practical control + WEAPON-NOTED. PRE-STAGE (design-side): Chain Whip {Novice} fires at the 3rd consolidating event (drill montage OR first live combat use). COST: stamina 54->46 (-8), focus 82->78 (-4), NO HP, NO backlash, NO Force tick. RE-RIG: dervish-flail re-rigged (core re-lashed to chain-end), now in tight-CoG handling; maul atk 10, inv 7. HELD DARK: he can ride the torque, and a dawning sense that DIRECTING the force would do far more (foreshadow of wielding) -- dark = wield/release mechanics, the affinity ladder, the real capability. system_card None. Ch5 OPEN. NO Tower reset.
